records.title: Primary-source lineage
records.claim: Jovian Archive identifies itself as the official source for the Human Design System and maintains Ra Uru Hu's recorded teachings and related educational material.

records.title: Long-form practical teaching
records.claim: Richard Beaumont's source describes decades of Human Design teaching and a large archive of long-form educational video and audio material, making it useful as a practical interpretation layer.

records.title: Traceable interpretation methodology
records.claim: The source publishes an explicit methodology that requires mechanical claims to trace to identified teaching material rather than to generic internet repetition.

records.title: Critical evidence boundary
records.claim: Independent commentary can distinguish precisely calculable birth-position astronomy from the interpretive claims made by Human Design and can therefore serve as a critical-context layer.
